Step 2: Extract the most relevant details about Tarian Astrel's background and role.
Answer: Tarian Astrel is a Force-sensitive human male who was born in 19 BBY as the son of Lumor Knight Velnor Astrel and Senator Padmé Amidala. He served as a revolutionary on the side of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Tarian Astrel played a crucial role in saving the Alliance from annihilation by destroying the Death Star during the Battle of Yavin.
